preconditions.expression: all(c in 'PO~' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of the characters 'P', 'O~', and '~O'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(input_string)) if input_string[i] == 'O~' and (i == 0 or input_string[i-1] != 'P'))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of 'O~' (rats going left) that are not immediately preceded by 'P' (the Piper).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(input_string)) if input_string[i] == '~O' and (i == 0 or input_string[i-1] != 'P'))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of '~O' (rats going right) that are not immediately preceded by 'P' (the Piper).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(input_string)) if input_string[i] in ('O~', '~O') and (i == 0 or input_string[i-1] != 'P'))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the total count of rats ('O~' or '~O') that are not immediately preceded by 'P' (the Piper), representing deaf rats going the wrong way.
